titles.title: Verdant Vale: Day Zero
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: An exhausted office worker is transported into an immense, luminous wilderness and given the chance to rebuild his life through practical survival craft.
titles.source_kind: Local manuscript, Dell replica, and KDP record

titles.title: Uncharted Hearts: Aeliana
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: John meets Aeliana, a forest elf whose knowledge of the Vale turns solitary survival into an alliance built through language, craft, and trust.
titles.source_kind: Local manuscript, Dell replica, and KDP record

titles.title: Wild Hearts: Mira
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: A magical trap introduces Mira, a gifted tracker whose search for her past joins the guardians' widening quest across Verdant Vale.
titles.source_kind: Local manuscript, Dell replica, and KDP record

titles.title: The Blighted Spring
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: The guardians combine wilderness engineering and magic to trace a corruption threatening the Vale's southern aquifer.
titles.source_ref: verdantvale/Verdant Vale 02.5 Day Three - The Blighted Spring.txt

titles.title: Trials of Valor
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: John and his companions enter personal trials where courage depends on confronting the shadow selves behind their deepest fears.
titles.source_kind: Local manuscript and Google Drive artifact

titles.title: Heart's Blossom: Seraphina
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: A disturbance at the Heart Tree leads the guardians through elemental trials and into an encounter with Seraphina, the nature goddess.
titles.source_kind: Local manuscript, Dell replica, and KDP record

titles.title: Arcane Seven: Mission Zero
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: A Bureau of Arcane Affairs team confronts an eldritch conspiracy as forgotten magical civilizations and modern threats converge.

titles.title: Then Came Man
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: Two linked narrative poems move from cosmic origins and early hominid survival to the invention of tools, kinship, and conflict.
titles.source_kind: Google Drive manuscript and KDP record

titles.title: The Color of Hope: Rubber Duck Self Optimization
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: A practical guide to self-reflection, healing, and growth that uses rubber duck debugging as a model for thinking through difficult experiences.
titles.source_ref: dell_books/Docs/The Color Of Hope_ Rubber Duck Self Optimization.docx

titles.title: Canticle of Champions: Alhen
titles.author: A. E. Mobley
titles.description: A young prince enters a mythic contest drawing warriors, mages, beasts, and demigods from across worlds and strands of time.

titles.title: The Match in the Maze: Carter
titles.author: A. E. Mobley
titles.description: Earth's superhuman protector is pulled through a portal to represent his realm in the Canticle's trials of ascension.

titles.title: The Taken Tome of Tsagatar
titles.author: A. E. Mobley
titles.description: A verse-bound fantasy entry in the Canticle cycle, following a stolen tome through a world made by divine music.

titles.title: Town of Monsters
titles.author: A. E. Mobley
titles.description: The fourth verse epic in the Canticle cycle enters a town where monsters and champions share a dangerous stage.

titles.title: Beast of Burden
titles.author: April Carter
titles.description: After their father's murder, Griffin and Sora cross the war-scarred land of Thraedon in pursuit of justice and the truth behind the Kin.

titles.title: Royal Blood: The Complete Epic
titles.author: April Carter
titles.description: A sweeping fantasy epic of inheritance, community, power, and the obligations carried by a contested royal bloodline.

titles.title: Echoes of the Abyss: A Tale of Lost Futures
titles.author: April Carter
titles.description: In the drowned city of Aqualis, a survivor navigates submerged streets and the relics of futures abandoned beneath the waves.

titles.title: Respawn City
titles.author: April May Carter
titles.description: Detective Maya Reyes remembers every death in a city where everyone respawns, making her the only reliable witness to impossible crimes.

titles.title: Spirit Punk: American Gods & Monsters
titles.author: Jason G. Fleece
titles.description: An augmented investigator reads both code and spirit residue while tracking a murder that violates the boundaries of physical reality.

titles.title: The New Founding: Friendly Fire
titles.author: Ron Helms
titles.description: A veteran navigates a nation governed by Trust Scores and omnipresent civic surveillance while resistance forms beneath its polished institutions.

titles.title: The New Founding: The Lighthouse Files
titles.author: Ron Helms
titles.description: An inherited video, a clandestine safe house, and an obsessive tally pull Maria Castillo deeper into the system behind the New Founding.

titles.title: The New Founding: American Harkina
titles.author: Ron Helms
titles.description: As a citizen's Trust Score collapses, an early-morning arrest exposes how rapidly the New Founding turns ordinary life into confinement.

titles.title: The Living Asteroid
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: A young gardener dreams of surviving the end of civilization while an approaching asteroid named Boombats quietly regrets its collision course.

titles.title: The Pearl Princess
titles.author: John Alexander Mobley
titles.description: A wave strider dives through the shining sea in search of a legend known as the mother of the sea.
